question: What is the name of the pilot project launched by the Delhi government to provide rest facilities for patient attendants at city hospitals?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Vishram Grih.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The Delhi government will launch the ‘Vishram Grih’ pilot project for patient attendants at city hospitals in the coming months.**
 
• **The project will offer rest facilities at hospitals such as Lok Nayak Hospital, Ambedkar Hospital, and Deen Dayal Upadhyay Hospital.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Vishram Grih will be available at a nominal charge of Rs 5 for one or two family members of patients.**
 
• **The facilities will include clean restrooms, proper bedding, and food arrangements.**
 
• **The pilot project will begin at four to five hospitals, starting with Lok Nayak, Ambedkar, and Deen Dayal Upadhyay hospitals.**
 
• **The initiative aims to provide a safe and comfortable space for hospital attendants, preventing them from sleeping on the streets.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **About Vishram Grih**__

 __
 
• The pilot project is designed to offer basic facilities to the attendants of hospitalized patients.
 
• The goal is to provide them with a safe resting space, reducing the burden of unsafe sleeping areas around hospitals.
 
 
 
• **Phases of Implementation**__
 
 
• The first phase will focus on providing the basic facilities at select hospitals, with the possibility of expanding later.
